projects.name: Tapinfi
projects.imageAlt: Tapinfi NFC digital business card and storefront visual showcase
projects.shortDesc: NFC-based digital business card platform with instant mobile profile sharing and product presentation.
projects.challenge: Professionals and teams needed a faster, eco-friendly alternative to paper cards that looks sharp on any phone without requiring an app download.
projects.objective: Design and present an intuitive digital profile card system paired with a clear product website.
projects.strategy: Prioritize sub-second mobile profile loading, crisp contact-save triggers, and clean product storytelling.

execution.design: Modular digital profile layout, tactile card mockups, and clean mobile-first typography.
execution.development: Responsive web profile renderer, tap-to-save vCard flows, and product landing experience.
execution.marketing: Conversion-focused product positioning and social sharing previews.

projects.results: Confirm verified adoption metrics before publishing public claims.
projects.clientFeedback: Pending written client/partner approval for public testimonial.

projects.name: CafeOS
projects.imageAlt: CafeOS hospitality and cafe operations interface illustration
projects.shortDesc: Cafe-management digital product focused on clean operational workflows, table/order flow, and clarity for staff.
projects.challenge: Independent cafes juggle counter orders, kitchen queues, and daily inventory across clunky legacy software.
projects.objective: Craft a fast, low-training operational dashboard and menu workflow tailored for busy cafe counters.
projects.strategy: Minimize taps per order, use high-contrast legible status cards, and separate counter vs kitchen views.

execution.design: High-contrast operational UI, modular order cards, and tablet/desktop responsive grids.
execution.development: Interactive workflow screens, structured state updates, and modular dashboard components.
execution.marketing: Product narrative positioned around speed and staff simplicity.

projects.results: Confirm verified operational time-savings before publishing public figures.
projects.clientFeedback: Pending written approval for public attribution.

projects.name: Vyapaar Saathi
projects.imageAlt: Vyapaar Saathi business workflow platform and analytics illustration
projects.shortDesc: Business-oriented digital platform built to simplify daily workflows and digital visibility for Indian SMEs.
projects.challenge: Small and medium business owners needed practical digital tools explained in plain, relatable language rather than enterprise jargon.
projects.objective: Unite a welcoming product website with structured business-tool workflows.
projects.strategy: Combine accessible English/Hinglish clarity with a trust-building visual system and straightforward onboarding.

execution.design: Clear visual hierarchy, approachable color tokens, and structured onboarding flows.
execution.development: Responsive web platform, lead/onboarding capture, and modular workflow views.
execution.marketing: SME-focused search positioning and conversion-oriented messaging.

projects.results: Confirm verified onboarding and engagement figures prior to public claims.
